description: Bitstamp's own EUR↔USD conversion rate — the buy/sell prices Bitstamp applies when converting fiat balances on the exchange, quoted with the exchange's retail markup (the two legs can differ by several percent). Use when you need the rate a Bitstamp account actually transacts at. For the market FX rate — "EURUSD spot", "current euro to dollar rate", anything macro or reporting-grade — use ecb_exchange_rate, which publishes the official euro reference rate.
name: eur_usd
title: Eur Usd
